extracted.intended_audience: Members of the public and registered users submitting comments on the Virginia Regulatory Town Hall (and agency/DPB staff administering forums)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and standards for submitting public comments to the Virginia Regulatory Town Hall: what the site will automatically change, what content may be hidden or moved by DPB, and privacy/public-record warnings for commenters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic blackout of profane or vulgar words
rubrics_metrics.description: Town Hall will automatically "black out" any words that are regarded as profane or vulgar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an automatic modification applied by the website; users should not expect to preserve profane/vulgar wording in public comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic disabling of active links and HTML
rubrics_metrics.description: Town Hall will automatically disable any "active" links to other websites or any other HTML code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you wish to include a link directly related to the comment forum, insert the full URL into the text of your comment (e.g., http://www.townhall.virginia.gov/UM/toc.cfm). Do not include active (clickable) links or embedded HTML; active links are not permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments are public records and publicly viewable
rubrics_metrics.description: All comments are publicly viewable; comments are public records posted on the Internet and can be found by most Internet search engines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not include information you do not want publicly disclosed. Please review your comment before submitting it because once posted it cannot be removed or edited other than the automatic changes described above.

rubrics_metrics.name: DPB may hide comments that violate the Public Comment Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: DPB staff may hide from public view any comments that violate this Public Comment Policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of comments that may be hidden include those that contain pictures; information not related to the comment forum (such as advertising); threats or personal attacks; or content invasive of privacy. When hidden, the comment is removed from public view, a note that a comment was hidden appears at the bottom of the relevant public comment forum, and the hidden comment remains visible to the agency that created the forum, remains part of the public record, and cannot be deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: DPB may move comments posted in the wrong forum
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments that appear to be posted in the wrong comment forum may be moved by DPB staff to the correct forum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Moves are done by DPB in consultation with the affected agencies. This ensures comments are located in the appropriate regulatory forum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance requirement (do not post unrelated or advertising material)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information that is not related to the comment forum (such as advertising) may be hidden by DPB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep comments focused on the regulatory matter of the forum; off-topic material risks being hidden or moved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for reporting suspected policy violations
rubrics_metrics.description: If you notice a comment that appears to violate this Public Comment Policy, please contact DPB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report suspected violations to DPB so staff can review and, if appropriate, hide or move the comment per policy.
